name: Lumius
description: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much. description: Integrated continual health-monitoring platform Americans and humans globally are facing multiple health crises, as they are plagued by chronic disease, which require consistent tracking in order to provide effective treatment. Generation of continuous data for monitoring and controlling these diseases is essential, as single-point tests do not effectively measure long-term trends, cannot provide early, proactive alerts, and do not enable measurements of efficacy of preventative measures. In order to bring this promising approach to continuous, real-time monitoring to life, Lura Health has solved a monumental engineering challenge and developed the world’s first salivary diagnostic wearable. This technology can be easily integrated into existing devices, such as retainers, implants, and dentures. Lura’s sensors are implemented in the mouth, providing real-time, continuous data that is sent to a patient’s smart phone, and shared with their doctor. Their first go-to-market opportunity is within dental applications, where the sensor will be used to monitor acid as an warning sign for tooth decay. They are also pursuing medical applications, starting with glucose monitoring for diabetes and electrolyte monitoring for chronic kidney and cardiovascular disease.

description: Regional Aviation Rethought! As a part of the emerging industry of Advanced and Regional Air Mobility, Manta Aircraft is developing an innovative and evolutive long-range eV/STOL air mobility platform to tackle 2 markets: > The one of the HELICOPTERS, existing and well known down to the details. We offer a very convenient alternative to helicopters, allowing "backgarden-to-backgarden" travel and a new type of flight services for private/public > and DEFENSE sectors in the urban and regional airspace. The vehicles are responding to real needs of specific industries, are designed for the roles of surveillance, rapid intervention (eg. disaster/emergency response), transportation of specialty material and persons, in the civil and defence environments - and are ready to evolve to new markets performing new types of missions. Key points of the programme: > eV/STOL: Vertical and Short Take-Off and Landing. The short take off option offers to triplicate the range > Long ranges 200-500+ miles (300-800+ km) at high speed 155-186mph (250 - 300 km/h), making it the eV/STOL combination with the longest range > Development of a platform as the base to generate multiple models (2-Seater, 4-Seater, 6-Seater, Cargo-Version, Unmanned/UAV) > Highly adaptable and reconfigurable for several different missions > A fraction of the operating costs of a comparable helicopter > Go-to-market strategy staggered in alignment with the certification steps, for a quicker ROI > An extremely experienced and qualified team, which accomplished more than 20 aircraft certifications (airplanes & helicopters): https://www.mantaaircraft.com/team > Scalability: easy global deployment, versioning for a wide range of use cases, aftermarket and technology revenues beyond aircraft sales. Regarding Manta's USP and differentiation in the market, I would like to highlight three key attributes: > Design - Optimised for vertical flight and for cruise as there are 4 propellers in the fuselage optimized for the vertical flight and 4 in the wings optimzed for cruise; > Hybrid Propulsion System - the turbo-generator allows the aircraft to cover long distances at high speed, whilst avoiding the need for special ground infrastructure like runways or for battery recharging stations, while the battery provides the energy to cover peak demanding situations like the vertical take off and landing > Modularity - Same subsystems used across multiple models, thus minimizing the cost of versioning, maximizing synergies and allowing for scaling up quickly as the aircraft could be assembled in several locations globally. The performance combination of Manta Aircraft provides executive advantages over helicopters, eVTOL air taxis, airplanes and drones. The accurate/verified design, the use of existing technology and off the shelf solutions where possible, the platform approach and the creation of assets along the development process are elements that de-risk the project.

name: Maritime Fusion
description: Fusion reactors for ships Maritime Fusion is building fusion reactors for ships and off grid energy markets. En route on this endeavor we’re commercializing High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) cable technology for power distribution while advancing the physics basis of our HTS tokamak to decarbonize global shipping. Breakeven fusion is coming soon, but the first-of-a-kind (FOAK) reactors will be costly, high maintenance, and have low capacity factors, leading to 5–10x higher electricity cost on the grid. Maritime Fusion is pursuing the most widely accepted approach to fusion, the tokamak, but specifically designed for the marine environment where the challenges that arise between breakeven and a commercially viable energy source are alleviated. The market we're targeting requires 15x less power, lower up-time, and costs the same as alternative fuels but without any emissions. Since fusion does not use highly radioactive fuels or materials – unlike fission – we sidestep the vast majority of regulatory challenges and safety risks associated with nuclear energy. Our team brings over a decade of industry and research experience in plasma physics, nuclear engineering, and electrical engineering with backgrounds at SpaceX, Tesla, Columbia University, and University of Pennsylvania.
description_alternates: Maritime Fusion is building the first nuclear fusion reactors for marine applications, using compact high-temperature superconducting technology to power shipping vessels. By avoiding radioactive fuels (e.g., from nuclear fission reactors) and leveraging a simpler regulatory pathway via a modular development model, the company is able to sidestep the cost and complexities facing other nuclear systems.

name: Masterpiece
description: Working capital for data companies training frontier AI We believe AI will be one of humanity’s next great masterpieces. Building it will require financial infrastructure as ambitious as the companies creating it. We're founders backed by Y Combinator building the financial rails underpinning the AI data economy. Masterpiece provides short term working capital to data vendors that sell training data, evaluation work, and reinforcement learning environments to frontier AI labs. A major financing gap exists in this market. Data vendors often need to pay contributors and fund operations before a lab has completed QA, accepted the work, and paid the invoice. This creates a 30 to 90 day cash gap between when vendors incur costs and when they receive payment. Legacy invoice lenders have little visibility into how to underwrite these assets. Masterpiece closes that gap by advancing capital against high quality lab contracts and invoices. Vendors can use the capital to scale delivery, pay contributors, and fund growth, then repay masterpiece when the lab payment arrives.

name: Mayan Finance
description: Mayan Finance is a cross chain auctions protocol built on Solana and Wormhole. They allow users to move assets between major EVM chains and Solana quickly and with minimal price impact. What distinguishes Mayan from other swapping protocols is that they don’t just rely on liquidity pools to change between assets. This can lead to large, unexpected slippage and churns users. Mayan holds auctions, where market makers and other protocols can bid on the order flow in a transparent, competitive process. This results in deeper liquidity for users and better execution prices. By building on Solana, Mayan is able to conduct these auctions entirely on chain (while their competitors build this off-chain), which increases trust, and transparency.

description: Mazlite provides an Industrial IoT platform for spray monitoring and digitization Spraying and coating is a 220+ billion dollar market. From cars to crops, from boats to batteries – spraying is a critical operation in many multi-billion dollar industries globally. But today’s practices are far from perfect. Specifically current spray processes for automotive are highly inefficient. These processes are high in cost, making up 30% of OEM operating costs; inefficient, with 30% of paint solids being wasted; riddled with quality issues, where 25% of parts have painting defects; all of this together leads to massive environmental Impact, making up 65% of OEM plants’ emissions. Mazlite has built a unique solution to these challenges, and is transforming the industrial spraying and coating industry with predictive quality control through physics-based AI, inline sensors, and advanced process digitization. Their solution elevates product quality, enhances sustainability, improves efficiency and lowers energy usage. Mazlite is transforming the industry by providing a pre-application spray monitoring and digitization solution. With their physics-based AI, they’re shifting industries from reactive corrections to proactive control. Data gathered through their pilots with major automotive OEMs has demonstrated that they enable global savings of $12.9B per year based on cumulative decreased spending on labor, down time, reduced defects, and reductions in waste.

name: Mediachain
description: The goal of Mine is to make metadata for digital images persistent and discoverable anywhere images exist. Today, information about an image, such as authorship or context, is quickly lost as it is shared across the internet. An image may start its life illustrating a news article on the New York Times, annotated with the photographers name and an insightful caption, but it quickly gets stripped down of any valuable context as it propagates different channels of the internet. We effectively know less about an image as it goes viral and reaches more people Mine wants to leverage the phenomenon of social image sharing in the production of a visual knowledge project. Mine uses computer vision to connect the thousands of different appearances of an image, over a thousand contexts and across any platform into one source image: where everything about that image can be collected and known. The entire ripple an image makes across the world is shown under one heading and the Mine community filters what information is most important. Our goal is to disinter mediate media consumption and interaction, which today relies on centralized platforms such as Facebook and Twitter which monetize their users and all the content that flows through them with little benefit to the communities that create that value. This is why we are building our dataset on top of the blockchain, the same technology that enabled two people to exchange a financial asset with no middleman in the case of Bitcoin. We have specified a proposal for our open dataset in the Canonical Content Registry: https://github.com/mine-code/canonical-content-registry

description: Medisafe empowers patients to stay on top of all their medications through a digital patient engagement platform. Its approach leverages the billions of data points collected to personalize patient engagement and improve adherence and persistence to medications. By addressing the major challenges of medication management utilizing a datascience-driven approach, Medisafe improves patient adherence and quality of care. description: Everything your team ships, explained to everyone it affects. Memoir is building a persistent and proactive AI teammate that helps an entire company keep up with its own progress. Think Instinct but for enterprise. We’re starting with product changes. When engineering ships something, Memoir understands who it affects and creates what each audience needs: a walkthrough for a customer, launch materials for a product marketer, or a technical explanation for another engineering team. We’re beginning with hands-on deployments, learning how each company works and where people depend on one another. Their chips are 10 times better, 10 times smaller and 100 times less expensive to manufacture than the state of the art technologies in this critical time keeping application.

description: M etabolic Psychiatry Labs treats serious mental illness through metabolism. People with conditions like bipolar disorder, major depression and schizophrenia often also struggle with obesity, insulin resistance and other metabolic problems, and each condition makes the other worse. Standard care treats the two separately, and psychiatric medication alone often has limited effect. The company runs a remote care program that combines psychiatric treatment with personalized metabolic interventions: diet, including ketogenic approaches, supplements and medication adjustments. Patients are monitored through an app that tracks lab results, glucose and ketone levels and mental health measures, and the data guides each person’s treatment. The company was founded by Dr. Shebani Sethi, who pioneered the field of metabolic psychiatry at Stanford, and is based in Menlo Park, California.
description_alternates: Metabolism-driven mental health care, personalized and remote Metabolic Psychiatry Labs delivers integrated mental health care that targets root metabolic drivers like insulin resistance, inflammation, and nutrition. Patients use connected at-home devices and a secure mobile app for daily mood, sleep, and energy tracking, plus coordinated remote lab testing and video visits. Board-certified psychiatric and metabolic specialists personalize treatment plans that combine medication management, nutrition interventions, and ongoing monitoring.

description: H eadquartered in San Francisco, Metabolize is building a new category of precision metabolite products for weight management. GLP-1 drugs have changed how people lose weight, but most patients stop treatment at some point because of cost, side effects or access, and most of the weight comes back. The approach is informed by recent human metabolism research published in Cell and Nature.

description: Automated e2e screenshot testing without writing or maintaining tests Meticulous is a tool to automatically catch UI bugs in your web application with zero-effort. Install our JavaScript snippet onto production or staging and dev environments, which records user sessions by collecting clickstream and network data. When you post a pull request, Meticulous selects a subset of sessions which are relevant and simulates these against the frontend of your application. description: Solid-state heating and cooling systems at a building scale Heating and cooling make up the majority of energy consumption in buildings, representing over 40% of energy-related greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Originating from extensive multidisciplinary research at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, MIMiC Systems is pioneering a technology aimed at reducing the emissions from refrigerants in traditional vapor-compression systems, while enhancing thermal comfort without incurring energy penalties. MIMiC employs advanced solid-state heat pumps, known as thermoelectric devices, combined with innovations in power electronics and controls. The technology is particularly advantageous for retrofitting residential buildings, streamlining the installation process to save both time and labor costs.
